origin: Original geometry, native Blender layered procedural PBR bakes, and original native vector artwork
placement: Pre-positioned for room x ±7, z ±6, y 0..7; open front at +Z
material_upgrade: 4K enamel and braided-sleeve atlas; 2K directionally machined steel; physically distinct paint, exposed metal, oxidation and oil layers; thin protective gauge glass; weighted corner normals; 2K native dial and screen typography
texture_sources: Six native Cycles-baked surface images plus two original native Blender vector renders; procedural source graphs retained in .blend; no downloaded photographs
geometry: Pressure vessels, compressor, control cabinet, gauges, bolted flanges, service pipes, vents, suspended fluorescent fixtures, tool crates
blend_preview_collection: Preview setup is excluded from GLB; includes ground, camera and lights
runtime: Self-contained GLB embeds textures. No external runtime downloads.
limits: Static decorative props; collision and hazard animation are handled by the game. Shader texture maps are authored procedural detail rather than scanned photographic materials.
gauge_glass: Thin neutral-tinted alpha-blended PBR reflection; roughness 0.1, opacity 0.13, no full-scene transmission pass
